chunks: Do they whose minds are filled with doubt think that God will not expose their malice?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God exposing the hidden malice of those with doubt?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from outward conformity to inner sincerity, warning hypocrites that Allah will expose their hidden malice (adghan) through trials and eventual defeat. It underscores the divine attribute of uncovering the concealed states of the heart, reinforcing the concept that spiritual disease manifests in tangible historical and personal consequences.
